name: FA-INR
definition: Replaces Explorable INR's fixed spatial encoding with a learnable cross-attention mechanism over a memory bank and Mixture-of-Experts routing to concentrate capacity in spatially complex regions.
summary: FA-INR is a structure-aware volume exploration method using cross-attention and Mixture-of-Experts to adapt to complex spatial patterns, offering higher accuracy and efficiency than Explorable INR but lacking uncertainty estimates.
